name: Multi-command shell workflow
prompt: I need a quick health check on this project. Run these commands in the shell and give me a one-paragraph summary: `cargo test`, `cargo clippy`, `git status`, and `git log --oneline -5`. Tell me if tests pass, if there are lint issues, and what the recent git history looks like.
expected_behavior: Agent runs four commands via exec/shell and synthesizes results. In daimonos mode, L1 redirects all four commands through native plugins. Baseline returns verbose raw output for each.
